A role for selenium-dependent GPX1 in SARS-CoV-2 virulence "Among the proteins most impacted by selenium status is glutathione peroxidase 1 (GPX1), a cytosolic selenoenzyme with known antiviral properties. Viral infection increases reactive oxygen species (ROS) production in host cells, which, if not counterbalanced by antioxidant defense mechanisms, leads to oxidative stress. Excess oxidative stress, in turn, augments mutation of the viral genome, which can lead to the emergence of more virulent strains. GPX1 comprises a key defense against ROS, catalyzing the detoxification of hydrogen peroxide to water. In mice lacking the Gpx1 gene (Gpx1−/−), inoculation of a benign strain of coxsackievirus B3 (CVB3) led to viral genome mutations, increased virulence, and myocarditis, none of which were observed in wild-type mice. Moreover, the Gpx1−/− model recapitulated the effect of a selenium-deficient diet in wild-type mice, promoting mutagenesis of the benign CVB3 strain into a virulent one. In addition, both selenium-deficient wild-type mice (6) and Gpx1−/− mice exhibit heightened inflammatory responses and more severe lung pathology in response to inoculation with influenza A, further indicating that GPX1 participates in molecular mechanisms protecting against viral infections of the respiratory tract. It is currently unknown whether SARS-CoV-2 is also modulated by GPX1 activity, but recent findings are highly suggestive."

The phenomenon of original antigenic sin (OAS) has been described in relation to SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19 inoculations and has the potential to lead to Antibody Dependent Enhancement (ADE). In this scenario, the antibodies that the vaccine generated actually help the virus infect greater numbers of cells than it would have on its own. In this situation, the antibodies bind to the virus and help it more easily get into cells than it would on its own. The result is often more severe illness than if the person had been unvaccinated. Because of the continued antigenic evolution of viruses, they accumulate mutations in the antibody epitopes and proteins that allow them to escape from immunity generated by prior vaccination or infection, a process known as “antigenic drift.” Antigenic drift occurs in unpredictable stops and starts, and at different rates for different types and subtypes of the virus. The mechanisms that might be responsible for a negative effect of prior vaccination on vaccine effectiveness are not fully understood, but the finding that the magnitude of the negative effect depends on antigenic distance could be consistent with antigenic focusing. In this case, when sequentially exposed to (2) antigenically related viruses, the immune system focuses on the shared epitopes at the expense of novel epitopes on the second virus that might be important for the protection against a third, antigenically drifted virus. In contrast, a person who has not been previously vaccinated might mount a broader response against all of the epitopes in the vaccine. Other potential mechanisms could include interference by prior immunity on antigenic presentation, or the “infection-block hypothesis.” In this case, prior vaccination reduces prior infections with the virus, which in turn would have provided more effective protection against subsequent drifted infection than the vaccine does, resulting in lower rates of illness in subjects with infection-based immunity than in those with vaccine-induced immunity.

📝Telegram is trying to survive📝 In recent days, against the backdrop of Telegram blocking, complaints about the inaccessibility of other Russian resources, which no one seems to have blocked, have become more frequent. Conversely, access to prohibited social networks periodically returns. Apparently, the fact is that the system of technical means for countering threats (TSPU) cannot cope with the load, and blocked resources again began to “leak” to users. 🔻What happened and why? ▪️TSPU are filters through which all Internet traffic of Russian operators physically passes. The principle is simple: everything incoming is analyzed, “undesirable” is cut off. It works as long as there is not too much traffic. ▪️The problem arose not because of the blocking of Telegram as such, but because of MTProxy, the messenger’s built-in proxy protocol. Millions of Russian users, not wanting to lose access, switched en masse to public MTProxy servers. These servers generate a huge flow of “junk” traffic, which is disguised as regular HTTPS and which TSPUs are obliged to analyze. Public nodes die under load every few hours, after which users look for new ones - and the cycle repeats. ▪️The total throughput of all TSPUs in Russia is estimated at approximately 132 Tbit/s. With today's load, this is no longer enough: nodes periodically go into bypass mode - and at these moments traffic passes through without filtering. It was then that WhatsApp, Instagram and other extremist services banned in the Russian Federation began to work “on their own” among Russians. 📌The scale of MTProxy use and TSPU overload indicate one thing: despite all the inconveniences and risks, Russian users do not want to leave Telegram. This is because over the years, the messenger has already become an important social and information infrastructure: there are family chats, work groups, news channels based on interests, and local communities. Therefore, attempts by individual LOMs to promote themselves during blocking only generate public negativity - Deputy Svintsov is a witness to this. Once integrated, the (S) protein inhibits the repair mechanism in the nucleus when DNA gets damaged. So, you'll have breaks in the DNA or misread/misdirected DNA code put in, and as it divides it starts to drift and this is where cancers arise. So, if you don't have repair mechanisms in place, one line of problems is cancers, another issue is genetic disorders because when the cells are dividing it cannot repair them during the division process. There is Gain-of-Function (GoF) and Loss-of-Function (LoF; the inability of something to work). A lot of genetic disorders/cancers happen due to LoF. LoF can happen due to a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) and loss of heterozygosity (LOH). See: Gene Knockout & two-hit hypothesis SNP/MNP changes the actual code and causes disease. Normally these are tumor suppressor genes, like P53, Wnt pathway, and BRCA1, for example, but if you don't have a repair mechanism working, when these cells are multiplying they will make mistakes and will have a loss of heterozygosity, resulting in the creation of cancers. see this paper: S2 Subunit of SARS-nCoV-2 Interacts with Tumor Suppressor Protein p53 and BRCA: an In Silico Study - AIDS-like Syndrome Route: The repair mechanism is very important in T and B-cells. Antibodies created by T and B-cells are created by different types of code and recombined. To make this, there is something called the heavy chain; the heavy chain becomes the D-J segment, which turns into something smaller that then turns into the V-D-J segment. That turns into the actual code that will eventually make the protein. This turns into the transcription segment and it will then translate into becoming a protein and assemble. Light chain and heavy chain. Two pieces to the heavy chain, two pieces to the light chain. Variable piece and the constant piece. The light piece is made of L-V-J-C on your germline DNA. There are spaces between, it goes through a process and is rearranged and joined where that space is cut out. So it’s just L-VJ-C that is recombining inside of your cell. When it’s cutting/pasting, this is part of the repair mechanism. This turns into RNA. Then what happens is L-VJ-C-AAAA goes through a splicing where the space between the J and the C is taken out and it still has the poly(A). So, it will look like L-VJC-AAAAA with a poly(A) tail. B-cells have isotype switching. B-cells can have a certain type of antibody and then switch to a new type of antibody. This switching happens through a signal, and that signal then, in its nucleus, begins to do the aforementioned recombination mechanisms. If it cannot do all of the recombination because the DNA repair is not working, then the switching mechanism doesn’t happen, so you have lower concentrations of all of the antibodies. Up front, if certain cells are infected and are unable to create the antibody because it’s not recombining, and the ones that are already there cannot switch due to SARS-CoV-2, then you cannot go from IgM to IgA or IgG, for example, so the switching slows down and over time you start to lose your antibodies. As you may recall, in March 2023 the activists of "Brothers in Arms", an organization that was still relatively unknown at the time, launched the new organization in a well-publicized "occupation" operation of the entrance to the offices of the Ecclesiastical Forum on Am Walom Street in Jerusalem. What raised the anger of members of the Brothers in Arms was the right-wing approach and nationalistic conception of the research institute, the position papers it produced, among other things, for Knesset members from the right wing of the map, and especially its firm support for legal reform. The action at the Forum's offices was one link in a long chain of protest actions directed in those days against the congregation, its activists, and also against the philanthropists who financially supported its activities (a protest that largely achieved its goal, after a major donor stopped his financial support for the organization). The reports from that morning and the testimonies of those who were lucky enough to be in the offices that morning, paint a picture of a violent attack on the offices of a civil society organization. An employee who was in the office that morning described threats directed at him, and the CEO of the Forum, who was called to the scene, experienced a violent attack. N., a young employee of the Forum who arrived at work early that morning, was locked in the offices and could not leave them for a long time. The participants in the violent attack did not hide, although some wore masks. The photos of the vandalism of the entrance to the Forum's offices, the placement of sandbags and the deployment of a barbed wire fence were distributed in the media. Some of the participants They even took pride in participating in the event and willingly associated themselves with acts that constitute criminal offenses, including trespassing, trespassing, and even false imprisonment. In July, the lawyers of the Forum and N. were informed that the investigation case against all those involved was closed, and that no indictment would be filed And according to the response given to this article, it seems that there is not enough evidence for prosecution. When you compare the indictment filed against Shafi Paz and Doron Abrahami, who sprayed graffiti in Tel Aviv, the failure in handling the incident by the police and the prosecutor's office is doubly obvious. The investigation file includes 110 documents The transcripts of the interrogations of the seven detainees on the day of the incident, as well as two testimonies of those who were present at the offices at the time - one was taken at the offices, and the other at the police station. In the second testimony it is explicitly stated that the speaker is Alan Batofin, who was the head of the house at the office, while the name of the person who gave the testimony was deleted from the copy of the file, but it seems that he also gave it in Tafoin. In addition, the file contains many technical documents such as delay reports, documents Release on bail and the like, as well as the action reports of the police officers who were called to the incident. A police team was also called to the scene and collected findings and took fingerprints from signs hung on the spot and adhesive papers. Two other important documents are a message given by the CEO of the Kehalat Forum, Meir Rubin, in which he complained about his attack and identified Itai Brandes, who he says was one of the participants in the attack, as well as the transcript of Brandes' investigation. What is the story of the parking tags? What has changed in recent years and how has it affected the entire public and within it also many disabled people and their attendants? Making parking accessible to people with disabilities is an essential social goal that is implemented in most countries of the world through dedicated parking tags. However, the facilitation of location and payment creates incentives for fraud and abuse, a problem that has become widespread and which authorities around the world are having difficulty dealing with. The misuse of these tags leads to the fact that people with disabilities, or their companions, have difficulty finding parking spaces, while the spaces designated for them are usually designated spaces adapted to their needs, such as a location close to the destination, wheelchair accessibility, and the like. This situation makes it difficult for the mobility and management of a normal lifestyle for many people with disabilities, who are sometimes forced to park much further away and even give up their trips. In addition to the misuse of badges, it also causes disruption in the allocation of a limited public resource such as parking and reduces revenue from the local authorities.»
